::: {.section-card}
### AI demand by economic sector (NACE)

AI-related postings are concentrated in **knowledge-intensive services**. More than **80%** of mapped AI offers fall in NACE sections **N (Professional, scientific & technical)** and **K (Telecommunications, IT & information services)**; manufacturing accounts for most of the remainder.
